text:
alice: Heads up — release cut for v1.12 is on hold. Staging artifact promotion failed verification for one shard: sha256:3a7b9f2d. Promote aborted by deploy-bot.

alice: Error in the promote log:
```
promote: head-object OK
promote: fetch artifact -> gzip: unexpected end of file
promote: verify failed for /artifacts/staging/v1.12/zone-eu-west-1/part-3.tar.gz
```

deploy-bot: :warning: Promotion halted automatically at 1701239876 due to checksum/verify failure. Ticket opened: infra#4217. Use `deployctl promote --dry-run` to inspect.

ben: Can reproduce locally against staging mirror. `sha256sum part-3.tar.gz` returns a different digest than index. Looks like multipart upload truncated one shard.

carlos: S3 HEAD shows content-length mismatch for that object. Suspect concurrent cache restore + upload race. I can trigger a re-upload from the build artifacts store if we want a quick unstick.

alice: Re-upload would unblock, but we need to be careful — release notes PR didn't land yet and docs still expect new flag change. If we force-promote now, customers might see feature without docs.

eve: Docs PR is blocked on a tiny changelog tweak. I can finish it in 15m. If we can get artifact re-uploaded and validation pass by +30m we can still keep the planned change window.

ben: Proposed plan: 1) carlos triggers re-upload of part-3 from build-cache (id: build-9092) 2) ci-bot runs promotion validation job again 3) if validation passes, we hold promote for 20m to give docs time to land, otherwise roll back to v1.11.

carlos: Started re-upload now. Command I ran: `./scripts/reupload-shard.sh build-9092 part-3 zone eu-west-1` — output says upload completed, etag mismatch fixed.

ci-bot: Validation job queued -> started. Running checksum and smoke tests.

ci-bot: Validation passed: all checks OK, smoke tests green.

alice: Docs PR merged :thumbsup: — eve nice. We still need to coordinate release notes publishing. Who will handle the notes post-cut?

eve: I can publish the release notes and update the changelog after promote. Will ping #marketing once published.

ben: Given the artifact race, we should add a short deploy-scheduler guard: if multipart upload detected, block concurrent cache restore for 2m. Filing follow-up infra task.

alice: Agreed. For now, hold the promote for an extra 10m to watch metrics, then let deploy-bot proceed. Thanks everyone. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
